title: R You Kidding Me (Four Mouths Four Ways)
style: global comedy funk, 100 BPM, theatrical multi-accent narrator, brass stabs, slap bass, tongue-twister rap, vocal R-trill effects, speech therapist intro, EN/ES/FR/DE/JP codeswitch, gospel choir bridge, comedic chaos, hooky chorus
lyrics:
[Intro — speech-therapist voice, dramatic]
Today's lesson: the letter R.
Roll it. Trill it. Gargle it. Swallow it.
Or — if you're English — barely move your tongue.
Begin.

[Verse 1 — Spanish rolled R]
"Erre con erre cigarro, erre con erre barril"
The Spanish trabalenguas — say it fast or you'll die
"Rápido corren los carros" — rolling rs like a freight train
If you can't roll, the Spanish say you're "no tienes lengua, pana"

[Pre-Chorus — global R complaint, building]
The Spanish R rolls like a thunderclap
The French R sits in the throat like a trap
The German R is harsh, gravel in the back
The English R barely happens, slack jaw, tongue relax

[Chorus — chaotic, multi-accent]
R you kidding me?
R you kidding me?
Same letter, four mouths, four ways to die
R you kidding me? Don't look me in the eye!
R-R-R-R [trill] (Spain!)
R-R-R-R [uvular] (France!)
R-R-R-R [gravel] (Germany!)
R-R-R-R [tongue flop] (USA!)

[Verse 2 — French uvular R]
"Rouge" — red — comes out of the throat like a frog cough
"Rrrrrr" en français — c'est très very tough
Tourists say "rouj" — the French say "noooon"
That's not the same sound, mon ami, you're done

[Verse 3 — minimum pair disaster]
In Spanish "pero" with a soft R means BUT
"Perro" with a rolled R means DOG, watch your gut
"Caro" is expensive, "carro" is a car
One trilled R changes meaning — that's bizarre

[Verse 4 — Japanese plot twist]
And then there's Japanese, where R is barely R
It's halfway to L, halfway to D, like a slurry slung tar
"Arigatou" — the R is almost a flap
The Japanese R is the chillest R on the map

[Bridge — slow, exhausted]
Speech therapy says "place the tongue here"
The mirror says "you look ridiculous, my dear"
Five months of practice for one rolled R
The polyglot's burden — articulation scar

[Final Chorus]
R you kidding me?
R you kidding me?
Same letter, four mouths, four ways to die
R you kidding me? Don't look me in the eye!

[Outro — whispered]
Rrrrrrrrr. [trills off into silence]
That took me three years.
Three years.
